content.comment_body: Hi, I'm working with [product_name] operator device and [product_name] PLC. I need to restrict access on the [product_name] operator device so that no one can set the PLC to STOP mode from the operator panel without a password.

Hello, Go to File > Properties > Parameter in the software—there you can set a password for the controller, and if you are using the operator device, the same password will apply to it as well. Regards,

Hello [user_name], thank you for your response. However, with these settings, the password does not protect the STOP function specifically on the operator device. Could you advise on how to set a password specifically for the STOP function?
Hello, Please refer to the relevant section of the attached manual for more information. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are discussing options to secure the STOP function on a [product_name] operator device within a [product_name] PLC setup. The main concern is setting a password specifically for critical operational actions rather than just controlling general device access. Current solutions cover general access control but lack granularity for protecting individual functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the ability to set a password specifically on the STOP function of the [product_name] operator device, rather than applying one for overall device access.
